meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: Claude 会先自己在真实界面上跑手动 QA 并留存证据(命令、截图或输出),再只派一个审查子代理,对照目标、约束、代码质量、安全与 QA 证据复核这次改动;QA 无失败行且审查代理 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接之前,或用户明确要求审查刚完成的工作时进入。手动 QA 若出现失败行,直接报 REVIEW FAILED 并跳过审查子代理。

say.text: 审查一下我刚完成的这次改动,走门禁审查。
say.note: Claude 先自己跑手动 QA,再派一个审查子代理。

say.text: 交接 PR 之前,先对这次实现做一遍门禁审查。
say.note: QA 有失败行就直接报 REVIEW FAILED。

say.text: 核对这次实现是否满足目标和约束,并附上 QA 证据。
say.note: 只启动一个审查子代理,不组审查团。

howto.what_en: Claude runs manual QA on the real surface itself, then launches ONE gate reviewer sub-agent to audit goal, constraints, quality, security and QA evidence. It passes only if no QA row fails and the reviewer approves.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. A failing QA row reports REVIEW FAILED and skips the reviewer.

say_en.text: Review the change I just finished as a gate review.
say_en.note: Claude runs manual QA first, then one reviewer sub-agent.

say_en.text: Run the gate review before I hand this PR off.
say_en.note: A failing QA row reports REVIEW FAILED.

say_en.text: Check this implementation against the goal and constraints.
say_en.note: Only one gate reviewer is launched, never a panel.
